# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 5.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 3.6.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 3.6   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of M4STCLAW seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT create a public GitHub issue.

Instead, please report vulnerabilities via:
1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting** directly on the repository: [Submit an Advisory](https://github.com/m4stanuj/M4STCLAW/security/advisories/new)
2. **Direct Security Contact:** Mast Anuj via GitHub profile [@m4stanuj](https://github.com/m4stanuj).

### Vulnerability Disclosure Process
- You will receive an acknowledgment of your report within 24 hours.
- A remediation patch will be tested and deployed within 72 hours for critical issues.
- You will be credited in the release notes for responsible disclosure.
